svg.title: Kubernetes Pod Lifecycle Management: overview, creation, init containers, probes, hooks, graceful shutdown, restart policy, deployments, deletion and controllers
svg.text: From creation to deletion: how Kubernetes manages the lifecycle of your pods
High availability, smooth updates, fault tolerance and graceful shutdown.
Official phases: Pending, Running, Succeeded, Failed, Unknown. Scheduled, Initializing and Terminating are conditions or kubectl statuses, not phases. kubectl get pod shows STATUS
such as Init:0/1, ContainerCreating, CrashLoopBackOff or Terminating.

Deleting a pod starts the grace period (default 30 s):
1 Pod marked Terminating; endpoint removal runs in parallel.
3 SIGTERM is sent to the container's main process.
4 The app finishes in-flight work and exits.
5 If still running when the period ends: SIGKILL.
